title: Skydive Saratoga
specs: Jump from about 9,000 feet with 30 seconds freefall and 5-6 minutes parachute descent
Views over the Adirondacks and Lake George area

services.name: Tandem Skydive
services.desc: By opting in to receive SMS messages from Skydive Saratoga, operated by Saratoga Xtreme, LLC, you agree to receive text messages related to your interactions with us. Messages may include responses to inquiries, reservation and appointment information, service updates, reminders, special offers, promotions, and other

includes: 20-minute plane ride over Lake George area
gap: Exact duration of the jump itself not stated
blurb: Guests book a tandem skydive including a 30-minute safety and procedural training. They jump from about 9,000 feet with an instructor, experiencing about 30 seconds of freefall and 5-6 minutes of parachute descent with views of the Adirondacks. After landing, guests receive a first jump certificate that counts as a loggable skydive.
extraNote: $100 non-refundable deposit required to book, applied to total cost · No refunds; all sales final · Reschedule up to 2 times for personal reasons with 48-hour notice to avoid forfeiting deposit · Groups of 5+ must reschedule 2 weeks prior to avoid $100 per person fee · Skydive Saratoga decides on weather cancellations; will reschedule if weather prevents jumping · Late arrivals may be rescheduled or forfeit deposit
